source: Observed, not recorded. Token response of the Tempo OAuth code exchange on the Atlassian test site on 2026-10-30: access_token, refresh_token, expires_in 2591999 and a space-separated scope of <area>:view and <area>:manage for every area. A live exchange needs a browser authorization, and a live refresh replaces the stored tokens, so neither is recorded. Token values are placeholders; the order of the scope entries was not noted.
